question: What is the function of the second tetrad and what is the primordial nature of all phonemes?
premises: The other tetrad is the single cause for establishing difference within non-difference.
All collections of phonemes are included in this account.
Originally, all phonemes are made of vowels.
inference: The phonemic system unfolds difference within unity, and its primordial substance is vowel-nature.
plain_english: The other tetrad is the sole cause by which difference becomes established within non-difference; thus, whatever collection of phonemes there is, all of it was originally made of vowels.
